claims.excerpt: must meet the conditions set by the safety commissioner before it can receive authorization to open the line.
claims.statement: The 7.5 km elevated Pink Line section (Kalena Agrahara–Tavarekere) completed a three-day statutory CMRS safety inspection on 6–8 October; it is not yet cleared for passengers and BMRCL must first meet the safety commissioner's conditions.
claims.subject: Bengaluru Metro Pink Line elevated section (Kalena Agrahara–Tavarekere)

claims.excerpt: Bengaluru Metro’s Pink Line faces 36 safety and technical deficiencies
claims.statement: Deccan Herald reported on 15 October that the Pink Line faces 36 safety and technical deficiencies. I could not open the article, so only the headline is confirmed. Metro Rail News (13 Oct) says BMRCL received CMRS observations on 9 October and planned to submit its compliance report on 13 October, but gives no count.
claims.subject: Bengaluru Metro Pink Line CMRS observations

claims.excerpt: Karnataka Chief Minister DK Shivakumar has sought a date from Prime Minister Narendra Modi to inaugurate
claims.statement: Chief Minister DK Shivakumar has sought a date from PM Narendra Modi to inaugurate the 7.5 km Pink Line section. The request went to the PMO the previous week and a response is awaited. BMRCL received CMRS observations on 9 October and planned to file its compliance report on 13 October. The opening may come around Dasara, with no date confirmed.
claims.subject: Bengaluru Metro Pink Line inauguration

claims.excerpt: K-RERA directed the developer to remove GST from the domestic water bill
claims.statement: Karnataka RERA ruled in a Kengeri apartment case, reported 14 October, that developers remain responsible for project-related expenses until possession. It directed removal of GST on the BWSSB domestic water bill and rejected delay interest of more than 600 days from 11 February 2024 that the builder had imposed without documentary evidence. The order date is not given.
claims.subject: K-RERA order on pass-through of project costs, Kengeri

claims.excerpt: signed a Joint Development Agreement (JDA) for a 12.76-acre land parcel in Sathanur
claims.statement: Puravankara signed a joint development agreement for a 12.76-acre parcel in Sathanur, North Bengaluru. It estimates a gross development value of INR 2,500 crore and about 1.90 million sq ft of saleable residential area. This is a developer announcement carried by PTI.
claims.subject: Puravankara Sathanur JDA

claims.excerpt: BMRCL has floated tenders worth Rs 6.86 crore to carry out geotechnical investigations in four packages.
claims.statement: Background, undated: BMRCL floated about Rs 6.86 crore of tenders for geotechnical investigations in four packages for the Sarjapur–Hebbal Phase 3A (Red Line). This is context for the 15 October lead on soil testing on Sarjapur Road, which I could not find or verify.
claims.subject: Namma Metro Phase 3A (Red Line) geotechnical tenders

claims.excerpt: Roads that were previously as narrow as 10 metres have been notified for widths of 30 metres, 45 metres and, in some cases, up to 90 metres, the GBA said.
claims.statement: Background, 29 September 2026: Karnataka notified a road grid for Bengaluru Urban areas outside the GBA. Roads previously as narrow as 10 m are notified at 30 m, 45 m and up to 90 m. Land in these corridors must be left vacant when new layouts or houses are built.
claims.subject: Road grid notification for Bengaluru Urban areas outside GBA (BMRDA)

structured_output.notes: The search tool was thin and The Hindu and Deccan Herald blocked fetches, so I verified only a few items. Not found or verified in the window: Hindu report on BMRCL soil testing on Sarjapur Road; BDA Karanth Layout deadline extension to 31 Oct (and the domicile-certificate story); Karnataka HC warning to BDA while upholding acquisition (ToI); GBA road network objections with maps unavailable (DH); Karnataka REAT Rs 2.45 lakh order (LiveLawBiz). Searches found no official BMRCL, BDA, K-RIDE or KIADB pages, and no cabinet, guidance value or stamp duty change in the window. The "Urban Acres" Pink Line March 2027 lead was not confirmed; other reports say the full corridor or the underground section is targeted for March 2027, but I did not record that as a claim. The metro heart-transport story is not property-relevant, and the search turned up a September 2025 precedent. Prestige Q2 (INR 7,225 crore pre-sales, 14 Oct) is a developer result, not government action, so I left it out of the claims.
